contract.description: Write a durable memory and get back the stored record - id, tome, scope, kind and supersede outcome - with your actor provenance on it. Call it when the human states a preference, decision or correction: write durable facts in English and keep the human's verbatim quotes as spoken; a near-duplicate supersedes the older record, an identical write replays it, and never store secrets. When the response carries nearDuplicates, the write landed close to existing memories - if one of them is the same fact restated, re-remember with supersedes set to its memoryId to replace it instead of keeping both. Scope 'Project' demands a registered projectId: pass one of the registered aliases, or omit it and the caller's working directory picks the registered project automatically (auto-tag) - the MCP server inherits the cwd of the client that launched it, so start it from the project root; an unknown projectId is rejected with the registered set, and on Global/Personal projectId stays optional provenance.
contract.name: memory_remember
contract.title: Remember a memory
